description:
Start a paid video job. Request follows POST /api/v1/videos/generations (supports mode="t2v", "i2v",
"r2v", "edit", "extend", and "a2v" with audio_url + optional image_url/prompt on ltx-2.5-fast / ltx-2.5-pro).

Wan models:
- wan3.0: unified 2-30 s (480p/720p/1080p; 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, adaptive; no 21:9, no negative_prompt
  or shot_type). Multi-shot via `Shot N [start-end]:` in prompt (<= 20000 chars); smart_duration=true
  (duration_seconds=-1) locks source length in mode="edit"; extend_direction="continue"|"prequel" +
  extend_seconds for mode="extend"; shot_mode ("auto"|"single"|"multi"), prompt_extend; up to 10
  reference_image_urls, 5 reference_video_urls (<= 15 s total), 5 reference_audio_urls (1-15 s WAV/MP3)
  with input + output <= 30 s (cannot mix image_url/last_frame_image_url with reference_*).
  Explicit shot timestamps and quoted Russian lines disable DashScope prompt expansion.
- wan2.7-r2v: up to 5 reference_image_urls + reference_video_urls combined; reference_audio_urls bind 1:1
  as per-hero reference_voice (WAV/MP3 1-10 s) in reference order; optional image_url (first_frame); 2-15 s
  without ref video or 2-10 s with ref video; input video billing capped at 5 s total; negative_prompt <= 500.
- wan2.7-videoedit: mode="edit" on 2-10 s video_url + up to 4 optional reference_image_urls; 720p/1080p.
- wan2.2-animate-move (keeps photo bg) / wan2.2-animate-mix (actor swap keeping video scene): 1 image_url +
  1 single-person video_url (2-30 s), 720p, quality_mode="standard"|"pro" (15/25 fps), no prompt/audio,
  input video not billed.

For minimax-relight use create_video_relight; for minimax-camera-controls use create_video_camera;
for lightx-recamera / lightx-relight use create_lightx_recamera / create_lightx_relight;
for ltx-2.5-alpha-gen use create_video_alpha_gen;
for topaz/flux/runway/ltx25 video upscale use create_video_upscale.
Not for higgsfield-* models: use create_higgsfield_cinema / create_higgsfield_genjutsu /
create_higgsfield_restyle / create_higgsfield_wan_prime.
name: create_video
